name: zclass_cls_di_filter_regions_against_hexahedron_faces
description: zClass_cls_di::FilterRegionsAgainstHexahedronFaces tests a center/radius against cached XZ edge planes.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the parallel vertex/edge-normal pointer delta and x87 status-word comparison remain expanded in HLIL.
No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this cls_di helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent cls_di source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4879c0 validates walking cached vertex and edge-normal arrays, computing the XZ dot distance, rejecting when distance is below radius, accepting after all cached planes pass, and accepting when the cached vertex count is non-positive.
The native DI region-filter smoke verifies inside, outside, radius-overlap, and empty-cache cases using production cached polygon data.
